name: Single Permit (Work + Residence)

requirements.blocker_text: A Romanian employment contract, deployment decision, or ICT-transfer assignment underpins the single-permit application.
requirements.fix_path: Secure an employment contract or intra-company deployment with a Romania-based entity.

requirements.blocker_text: Proof of financial means of support at least equal to the gross minimum salary in the economy.

outcome.duration_length: typically 1-2 years matching contract length; senior workers up to 3 years; ICT managers/specialists up to 3 years, ICT trainees up to 1 year

sources.title: General Inspectorate for Immigration (IGI), Romanian Ministry of Internal Affairs -- Single Permit (work + residence combined): covers standard employees, deployed workers, ICT transferees, and business heads/representative-office managers; minimum-wage-level financial proof; initial 1-2 year duration tied to contract, extendable to 3 years for senior workers, ICT-specific caps; 30-day processing (extendable 15 days)

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Romania). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- tier-1 IGI sourced. work_rights is 'restricted' rather than 'full' because the permit is tied to the sponsoring employer/contract (a job-offer-status limitation, consistent with this dataset's convention for employer-sponsored work routes elsewhere) rather than an unrestricted labour-market permit; the source did not specify a labour-market test or quota system, which is disclosed as a gap rather than assumed absent. pr_after_months/citizenship_after_months are set using Romania's general long-term-residence (5yr/60mo, see ro_permanent_residence.json) and naturalisation (8yr/96mo, see ro_citizenship_naturalisation.json) thresholds as the applicable path forward for a single-permit holder who accumulates continuous legal residence on this route -- this is an inference from the two other tier-1/tier-2-sourced files, not a separately confirmed IGI figure for work-permit holders specifically, and is flagged as such. Fee amounts were referenced by the source as existing but not stated in figures, and are left undisclosed rather than guessed.
